system.description:
You grasp a hand full of poisonous Lotus petals, spreading them in a wide cone originating from yourself in a dance of anger.

As they flutter in front of you, all creatures within range must make a Charisma saving throw to as the pollen begins to affect their emotional state.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: Affected creature enters an enraged state. For the duration, enraged creatures increase the cost of all Jutsu they cast by +4 believing they are upcasting and putting more force behind their castings. Affected creatures remake their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they do not remake their saving throw at the end of each of their turns.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the number of targets by +1 and the cost of the affected creatures jutsu by +2.
